# Day 5 — Linear Algebra

Day 5 opens with linear algebra as a **reading key**, not a course: enough
notation to read a matrix expression, name the shape of every piece, and say
whether an operation is conformable. Vectors and the dot product, the design
matrix, transposes and matrix types, and finally a regression written out as
a system of equations — with the estimator $\hat\beta = (X'X)^{-1}X'y$ read
left to right rather than derived.

Deliberately out of scope: determinants, inverses beyond the notation,
eigenvalues, rank, span, and the projection picture. Those belong to the
post-camp linear algebra series, which this session is meant to prepare you
for rather than compete with.

This session has one part:

- **[Math Session](slides.qmd)** — the in-class slideshow, closing with an
  interactive $3\times3$ matrix you can type into.

The day's programming session (**Coding with AI**) is paired with
[Day 5 — Intro to Advanced Topics](../05-advanced-topics/index.qmd).
